spec_atomic_units: The module has clk, shift_ena, count_ena, data, and q as inputs and outputs.
When shift_ena is high, data is shifted into the MSB of q.
When shift_ena is high, existing bits of q are shifted to the right.
When count_ena is high, the value of q is decremented by 1.
The behavior is undefined when both shift_ena and count_ena are high.
The module operates on the rising edge of the clk signal.
Shift and decrement operations are triggered by the rising edge of clk.
The setup and hold times for clk, shift_ena, count_ena, and data relative to the rising edge of clk are critical for correct operation.
q will change after the rising edge of clk, with a delay determined by the flip-flop propagation delay.
The register 'q' is updated on the positive edge of the clk signal.
The shift operation involves shifting the existing bits of 'q' to the right and loading the 'data' input into the MSB.
The decrement operation involves subtracting 1 from the current value of 'q'.
Non-blocking assignments (<=) are used to update the register 'q' to avoid race conditions.
